newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Village bids for rest of Austereo.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Village bids for rest of Austereo.

text.p: Entertainment group and cinema operator Village Roadshow Ltd said on Thursday it would offer A$2.35 per share for stock it does not already own in radio group Austereo Ltd.
Village also said it would raise A$59 million from the underwritten issue of 13 million ordinary shares at A$4.55 each.
Village now owns 52.83 percent of Austereo, or 92.043 million shares.
Austereo shares ended steady at A$2.43 each on Thursday.

Village said the average closing price of Austereo in the three months to March 12 was A$2.09. "Based on this Village Roadshow believes that the proposed bid price is fair and reasonable to the other Austereo shareholders."

The 13 million share issue has been fully underwritten by ANZ Securities and would be placed with institutions, it said, with a further 4.4 million Village shares to be placed with MAI Danmark APS at A$4.55 each which would raise A$20 million.
MAI Danmark currently owns 18.70 percent of Village and foreign investment approval would be required for the placement.

Village said other share placements would consist of a 2.4 million issue to The Capital Group Inc, raising about A$11 million, and 6.4 million shares issued to parent company Village Roadshow Corp Ltd, raising about A$29 million.
Capital Group now owns about 8.27 percent of Village while Village Roadshow Corp has 52.14 percent.
Village said the remainder of the funds would come from a A$230 million facility from the ANZ Bank
Village shares ended nine cents lower at A$4.75 on Thursday, with the placement agreements struck on Monday when the stock was A$4.55.
